sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Traffic is a simple game that requires players to navigate a vehicle through a busy traffic system. The game starts with a single lane, but as you progress through levels, the traffic gets thicker, and new lanes are added. Your goal is to reach the end of the level without colliding with any other vehicles. Sounds easy, but it's not. The traffic is moving at different speeds, and you'll need to time your movements perfectly to avoid collisions.

The gameplay is incredibly addictive, and the challenge level increases steadily as you progress through levels. You'll need to keep an eye on the traffic, anticipate upcoming obstacles, and make split-second decisions to avoid collisions. The game also features a 'time trial' mode, where you'll need to complete a level as quickly as possible. This adds an extra layer of challenge and competitiveness to the game.
